name: The ethics board says no
text: Withholding or assigning the exposure is judged unethical. No one may be allocated to it.

name: Funding cut
text: You now have six months and a tenth of the budget.

name: Rarer than you thought
text: New data: the outcome affects about 1 in 20,000, not 1 in 200.

name: The registry door opens
text: A national registry with 20 years of linked records becomes available to you.

name: The ministry sets a threshold
text: Eligibility will be decided by a score: everyone above 60 gets it, everyone below doesn't.

name: It's happening anyway
text: The decision is made: everyone gets the intervention within a year. Only the order is open.

name: They talk to each other
text: Participants share tips, materials and gossip. Anything you give one of them, the others get too.

name: Only one
text: It turns out there is only one eligible unit: one patient, one plant, one country.

name: Thirty studies just dropped
text: A literature search reveals dozens of primary studies on this exact question.

name: Into the fog
text: Experts can't agree what the key variables even are.

name: Slow burn
text: The effect, if any, would take 15 years to show.

name: A brief trigger
text: The suspected cause lasts minutes, and the effect comes within hours.

name: Only a few are exposed
text: The exposure is confined to a few hundred people at one site.

name: Reviewer 2
text: The Reviewer may play one extra Threat against every design this round.

name: Replication crisis
text: Any design not defended with Preregistration or Independent replication loses 1 point this round.

name: Open science prize
text: +1 point to every player who plays Preregistration, Triangulation or Independent replication this round.
